steps.content: Plant your feet there and hold onto me.
The fastener around your waist snaps tight, and you instinctively grip the person in front of you.

You struggle to find purchase on the slick surface of the sheer cliff. Unlike your companion, who clings to the wall with hawk-like agility and stability, you arduously try to push off with your feet a few times, but fail.
...Engage your core. You need to work out more.
Hang in there. We can survive this wave.
Screams wash over the area in waves, drawing closer from the distance. The darkness fills with growls and terror.

steps.speaker: Terrified Man
steps.content: Up ahead! The shelter is right up ahead! The key! Who's got the key?!

steps.speaker: Weeping Woman
steps.content: N-no idea! I think Rou... you know, that girl, had it. Where did she go?!

steps.speaker: Terrified Man
steps.content: **** it, first we need to survive this! Just don't let them catch us! Ahhh!!!
The person in the lead runs desperately toward the corner where you're hiding, swinging the flashlight frantically with each movement.

Behind the two people scrambling below is a tide of countless monsters with glowing red eyes. Drooling and baring their razor-sharp fangs, they tear apart anyone who falls behind. Each monster's body is contorted into an inhuman, grotesque form.

steps.speaker: Corpse Tide
steps.content: Grrrr... Grrrrowl!!!
In the erratic flashes of light from the chaos, you finally see your situation clearly:

Below you is a terrifying drop, with sharp rocks and mechanical traps littering the bottom. In front of you, Lysandra hangs suspended by a single rope, occasionally shifting the thin stick in her mouth. Her breathing remains steady as her calm gaze sweeps over the fleeing crowd below, locating the shelter not far away.
As for you, you're simply fastened to her body in a neat and secure fashion...
...just like a tool pouch casually strapped to her side.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Focus. Everyone else is already dead. It's just the two of us now. Control your breathing. Don't let them detect us.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: We're running out of time. The shelter is just ahead...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Why are you trembling? Are you acrophobic? Just hold on to me tighter.

options: The fastener is so tight my circulation is getting cut off...

choices.text: The fastener is so tight my circulation is getting cut off...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Whatever. Let's move.
You hear a countdown begin somewhere. Ten, nine, eight...

Before you can finish speaking, Lysandra's body is already in motion. She precisely locates each tiny handhold on the seemingly smooth rock face, moving up and down with fluid agility, momentarily suspended in the air before landing precisely... Through your dizzy vision and the heart-stopping weightlessness, you see the shelter drawing ever closer.
Five, four, three...

steps.speaker: Terrified Man
steps.content: We're almost there! The gate! Can't open the gate without the key! What do we do?!

The shelter is within arm's reach, its entrance firmly secured by solid rock on all sides. There is only a small gap at the top, filled with massive stalactites hanging from the dome like interlocking fangs...
One!

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Now, duck down.

The buckle at your waist is suddenly yanked upward, and an enormous centrifugal force hurls you through the air! Through the rushing wind, you hear Lysandra's wrench whistling alongside you through the darkness, heading straight for the stalactites.

Time seems to have frozen. You open your eyes mid-air in a daze, witnessing Lysandra's wrench precisely shattering each stalactite hanging from the dome, clearing your path. The falling fragments trace the very edges of your eyelids as they narrowly miss you, one after another, like a movie scene in slow motion. You sigh, resigning yourself to fate as you close your eyes.
Bang!
Wham!!!
[Transition 2s]
[Screen brightens, view from inside the cage]
Clank... Clank...
The lights inside the shelter flicker on. Through the cage-like gate, you can see in the distance the stone entrance to the final tomb has slowly begun to open.

The Corpse Tide suddenly comes to a halt. One by one, the monsters begin lifting off their masks, revealing staff members underneath who are exhaling heavily and wiping away the sweat covering their faces.

The two players who were running for their lives moments ago collapse to the ground, nearly fainting as they wave their hands frantically. The Corpse Tide crew immediately help them up, supporting them as they walk side by side past the shelter. When they step over the mess of shattered stalactites covering the ground, they shoot nervous glances at you and Lysandra before timidly shuffling away, eager to escape the area.
Among the departing Corpse Tide, you spot a familiar silhouette bouncing playfully along with them...
Lysandra leans casually against the gate with her arms crossed, her eyes scanning the area outside.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: The kid who came with us, where'd she go? What's her name again, Roulecca?
[Roulecca's portrait]
It's Roulecca who's leaving with the Corpse Tide crew. She turns around to make a silly face at you both, jumping up and waving. You can see her face is covered in sweat from all the excitement.
Yet strangely, not a single one of the Corpse Tide actors has noticed her, as if she were actually one of them.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That kid... her luck never fails her. Made it all the way here without being spotted...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ahem, she's fine. Looks like she's found something more thrilling to do and wandered off on her own.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: DisCity folks... no, Eastsiders sure are an interesting bunch.
Standing beside you, Lysandra follows your gaze in the direction where the Corpse Tide crew have gone and comments offhandedly.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: This escape room thing is some kind of game, right? No money at stake. No lives at risk. Just for fun.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: They live such sheltered lives that they feel the need to recreate the treacherous WhiteSands tombs for fun. But if you actually dropped them into a real WhiteSands crypt, they'd sure be wetting their pants.
She articulates her words like she doesn't care whether you're listening or how you might react.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Tsk... A few cozy days in and I've already let that kid provoke me.
You pat Lysandra on the shoulder.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can't be helped. Roulecca's the luckiest person all of us have ever known. Nobody ever wins a bet against her.
...Well, just as you suspected, this whole situation is the result of Roulecca's elaborate scheme to get herself out of the Bureau.
[Flashback to the Bureau]

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ah!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I'm sooo bored...
Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!
Eyes closed, Roulecca hangs upside down from the gym equipment in the Bureau's Training Room, casually firing her gun in random directions with her good arm.
The smoke clears to reveal perfect bullseye shots on the entire row of targets before her.
Roulecca opens her eyes and immediately heaves a bored sigh. As expected, every single one of the casually fired shots has found its way to the throats of the human-shaped targets.
The machines whir and the battered targets are gradually lowered while new ones rise into position. Roulecca's face is all scrunched up.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ahhh! Sooo bored!!!

steps.speaker: Echoes
steps.content: Booored... ed... ed...
In the empty Training Room, only Roulecca's own echoes respond to her. She glances down and fidgets with the bandage on her hand.

A few days ago on a mission, Roulecca carelessly sprained her wrist. But fortunately, if she hadn't injured herself at that exact moment, the Corruptor's attack would likely have caused her far more serious harm.
To ensure her proper recovery, the Bureau has separated her training sessions from the others'. It's been three months now, and Roulecca hasn't seen another soul during her training hours.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmm? Is someone there?!
Nearby, a woman with grayish blue hair braided into a plait is doing her regular training methodically. Her arm is wrapped in bandages which tighten and loosen with each controlled movement.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: That lady... that lady... Oh! I remember her!

Roulecca's first impression of her goes back to a flyer advertising a newly launched, massive escape room in Eastside with a WhiteSands Underground Tomb theme. This woman here, apparently a recent detainee in the Bureau, sneered at that flyer that got Roulecca all hyped up.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: It's fake, no matter how immersive they claim it is.
A mischievous glint flashes in Roulecca's eyes as she creeps near the training woman.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Well, well, if it isn't Miss Lysandra!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Why are you training here all by yourself? Aren't you a tomb raider? Has Chief not let you out on parole to stretch your legs and do some leisure grave-robbing?
Completely ignored by Lysandra, Roulecca pouts sulkily.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Isn't it so boring to be training here? Don't you want to go do something fun with Roulecca instead?
Lysandra's training is interrupted yet again as a crumpled flyer is thrust before her eyes. Finally, she turns her attention to Roulecca.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Since you can't get out on parole yet, why not come with Roulecca to this place instead?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I overheard Chief's conversation with Adjutant Nightingale the day you arrived. They said you're an exceptionally skilled tomb raider. It's been months now, aren't you itching to get back to it?
Roulecca clutches the escape room flyer, inching closer to Lysandra with an expression that clearly says she'll keep pestering Lysandra until she agrees to go with her.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Do you have any idea what a real tomb in WhiteSands looks like? The mechanisms and traps inside can't be overcome with mere luck alone, kiddo.
Roulecca points at the flyer and edges even closer.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Really? But it says right here that besides the fixed route, there are also special lucky exits...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: I've also heard people say that the tombs in WhiteSands are so deadly that those who make it out alive... must have at least a little bit of luck on their side.
Lysandra looks at Roulecca, then follows her gaze downward to find a coin wedged on the edge of her own pocket. Her brow twitches slightly as she pushes it inside.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Care to make a bet with me, Miss Tomb Raider?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Let's see which is more powerful—my luck or your skill?

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: ...You have no idea what you're getting yourself into.
[Scene Transition: Chief's Office]
A flyer of a recently launched escape room in Eastside is thrust into your hand.

CRAZY DEAL! The most immersive, authentic, and challenging experience now awaits you at XXX Escape Room in Eastside! Sarcophagus Rendezvous—Try our tomb raiding-themed room with a team of three or more! Group discounts available! Only 998 DisCoins if your group succeeds! Find your way out and take home the grand prize! Prizes also available for successful escapes through lucky exits!
[Roulecca's portrait and Lysandra's portrait side by side]
Since Lysandra was detained by the Bureau, this is the first time you've seen her outside of her room and the Training Room.
But... why is she with Roulecca, of all people? You notice Roulecca standing behind Lysandra with a triumphant smirk on her face, and guesses begin to form in your head.
Lysandra stands at your office doorway with her arms crossed, maintaining a calculated distance from you, her face completely expressionless.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: I need to get out, to this escape room. This kid is coming with me. We need two permits.
Surprise seizes you for a moment.
Lysandra has always strictly followed the Bureau's rules for Sinners and never asked for anything in particular. This is the first time.

But then you've also barely had any chance to truly get to know this reticent Sinner. You only ever glimpse her in the Outdoor Activity Area silently gazing up at the simulated night sky on your way back to your quarters after working late.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Is something wrong?

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: We need to get out. We need two permits.
Lysandra seems to struggle with reading complex facial expressions on others. Noticing your silence, she simply restates her purpose, even slowing down a little deliberately.
You don't know what to feel about this.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ah, nothing... I'm just a little surprised. This is the first time you've approached me on your own, and you're requesting to go out with Roulecca.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Both things are quite unusual, so I was taken aback for a moment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: May I ask why?
She lets out a small oh, shifts the thin stick in her mouth and answers rather languidly.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Never been in DisCity. Never tried your escape rooms.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Haven't gone tomb raiding in ages so I'm getting an itch. Want to form a team. With three people we can get in.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: That's it.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: You won't lose out. Think of it as a tomb raiding job. Once we get the treas... the grand prize, you'll get a 10% cut. But you need to pitch in first.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Only 998, crazy deal.
Lysandra extends her hand to you with a deadpan expression while Roulecca frantically winks and makes faces at you.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: It's a super bargain, Chief! A once-in-a-lifetime chance to go on an adventure with a real tomb raider—and not just any tomb raider, but one I've only read about in books!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Don't you want to come along too?
You grasp Lysandra's extended hand and finally manage to get back on your feet, albeit still covered in dirt.

Hoping to use this opportunity to better understand this Sinner who's been nothing but a model detainee since her arrival, you handed the permits to Lysandra and Roulecca, but only after repeatedly reminding Roulecca to be careful with her injured hand and making it clear that you must accompany them.

Up until the Corpse Tide chase, the stages were so simple that Roulecca could clear them just by randomly tapping a brick on the wall or rearranging some items. The easy challenges left Roulecca disappointed and she was throwing a tantrum about wanting to leave halfway through. Meanwhile, Lysandra kept walking behind you two indifferently.

It wasn't until you entered this thrilling stage that gradually transformed into a multi-level arena with immersive theatrical elements that Lysandra finally became more animated. Looking back, you accomplished the challenge with ease under her guidance while witnessing a side of her you'd never seen before.
Clack!
The shelter's gate swings open with the sound. The Corpse Tide is completely gone. It seems the next stage is ready.
Lysandra tightens the bandages on her hand. Before setting off again, she looks directly into your eyes with unexpected seriousness.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: The MBCC's been a cozy stay. There's always food, drinks, and a warm bed waiting for me. No need to wonder where I'll wake up tomorrow, or if I'll wake up at all.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: I guess I can understand now why you'd want to throw yourselves into this kind of unnecessary trouble.
Her tone remains perfectly calm, but in the dim chamber, you see her remove her goggles, revealing a pair of bright, serene eyes.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Let's do this then, Chief. I'll make sure you get your money's worth.
Without another word, she strides through the gate and heads toward the final chamber.

Watching her back, you notice how expertly she navigates the place with her professional gear and excellent instincts, advancing with steady confidence. Almost unconsciously, you find yourself following behind her with complete trust.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: ...Wait.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: From now on, step only where I've walked. Don't place your feet anywhere else, and don't touch anything.
Her voice flickers like the lights of the chamber.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: There's indeed something big in this final chamber...

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Interesting.
As you move forward, you feel wind blowing from the far end of the chamber, carrying waves of dry, scorching air. You recognize this scent. It's the unmistakable sandy smell of WhiteSands.
You furrow your brow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What's going on? This sandy smell...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why does it smell like this here? How's that possible?
While carefully following Lysandra's exact path, you take out your comms device to search up this escape room, but all you can see on the screen is searching for signal.
You stand still, holding your device up at various angles and even giving it a few hopeful taps.
A moment later, it finally catches a signal after being disconnected for so long. Immediately, it vibrates rapidly with the influx of messages.
Five minutes ago.

Roulecca: Chief, here's something super exciting Roulecca has just discovered!

Roulecca: And by that I mean joining the Corpse Tide! It's sooo much fun! I just have to twist my body like they do and chase after the other players, and I can make anyone abandoned by their friends play roulette with me!

Roulecca: Oh, right! While mingling with the Corpse Tide, Roulecca overheard some super important intel! They say nobody has reached the final level since the launch! And that last stage is the real immersive, authentic, and challenging part! The owner spent tons of money creating it based on their experiences trading in WhiteSands. I'm sure Lysandra knows all about that! Roulecca: K, gotta go! Will meet you guys when I'm done having fun! Love ya, Chief!!! <3
[Turn off device]
You look up.

At the far end, Lysandra is crouching down examining something. Looking ready to proceed, she stands to face you. In the faint light from the cave entrance, all you can make out is the glint of a coin being flipped up and down, and the blurred outline of her enigmatic half-smile.

steps.speaker: Lysandra
steps.content: Ready for a truly nasty WhiteSands tomb, Chief?
